st: Every day can be a “Perfect Day”

sec.p: Today, a "dialectical" reflection, exploring the contradictions I face every day and in which, perhaps, many of you will recognise yourselves.

sec.t: ff.108.2 Through the eyes of the inner child
sec.p: In Wim Wenders's film Perfect Days (2023), the protagonist, Hirayama, finds novelty in the changing leaves on the trees, in the play of morning light, in the small variations of his methodical life cleaning Tokyo's public toilets.
One element of variation in the film is the books the protagonist reads.
Tao = Creation (and creativity). The book also speaks of a mysterious force, feminine, creative; mother of novelty. It's up to us to notice it.
